set.body:
Purpose:
Evaluate Cats Effect at the actual side-effect boundary without infecting the shared BIDS model.

Scope:
- Add an opt-in BidsLoader[F] or BidsProjectLoaderF[F] JVM API while retaining the synchronous loader during the pilot.
- Suspend java.nio.file operations with Sync.blocking/interruptible as appropriate.
- Manage Files.walk, Files.list, and other AutoCloseable resources with Resource.
- Translate expected filesystem/decoding failures into the domain error/report model while preserving useful cause/operation context at the JVM boundary.
- Add configurable bounded concurrency for independent sidecar/table reads; final output and diagnostic ordering must remain deterministic.
- Use EitherT only internally if it makes F[Either[...]] composition clearer.
- Do not call unsafeRun methods in library code and do not add effect parameters to BidsProject/BidsManifest/BidsTable.

Acceptance:
- Tests prove stream finalization on success, failure, and cancellation.
- Blocking calls are not executed on the compute pool.
- Concurrency never exceeds the configured bound and does not change result ordering.
- Strict/permissive behavior and successful project output match the synchronous loader.
- The pilot records an explicit keep/reject decision and dependency footprint.
set.title: BIDS F4: pilot a resource-safe Cats Effect JVM loader
